label: sparse mix: early copy-phase input h / original-phase step after p
explanation: Sparse feature (0.15% of steps) that never fires at t=0 or 1. Activity is spread across contexts with only modest lifts: input h (12x, mostly early copy steps where h is echoed back, e.g. orig(0)=h at recall_idx 1), the step after input p in the original phase (12x, highest when p is preceded by p/j/2), and sequences starting with h/j/c. No single predicate reaches precision above ~20%; the best two-clause disjunction gets dev F1 0.16 and mass recall 0.44. Magnitude is narrow (median 0.12, max 0.27) and no condition we checked clearly modulates it. Each candidate context (input h in copy, prev p in original) is inactive on the large majority of its occurrences.
